shortDescription: NetApp E-Series create, remove, and update asynchronous mirror groups

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: interfaceType
options.description: The intended protocol to use if both Fibre and iSCSI are available.

options.name: manualSync
options.description: Setting this to true will cause other synchronization values to be ignored

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the async array you wish to target, or create. If C(state) is present and the name isn't found, it will attempt to create.

options.name: recoveryWarnThresholdMinutes
options.description: Recovery point warning threshold (minutes). The user will be warned when the age of the last good failures point exceeds this value

options.name: secondaryArrayId
options.description: The ID of the secondary array to be used in mirroring process

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: A C(state) of present will either create or update the async mirror group. A C(state) of absent will remove the async mirror group.

options.name: syncWarnThresholdMinutes
options.description: The threshold (in minutes) for notifying the user that periodic synchronization has taken too long to complete.
